# Original regression fixtures

These are frozen builds and numerical reference data generated from earlier approved versions of this project's own code. They contain no third-party bird models, images or ascii-sharks code.

The dates in the JSON files record visual approval during local development; the fixture names are not Git tags or published releases. Keep the executable `.js` bundles byte-identical: the browser harness uses them as independent rendering references. The Node tests also protect mesh, pose, geometry and reference-media hashes.

The fixtures and their project-generated recordings in `docs/reference/` are covered by the root MIT license. They are excluded from formatting and linting to preserve the references.
